name: Chlorophyllum molybdites
notes: Makes large fairy rings in tropical and subtropical lawns and pasture.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): rings on warm lawns widen much faster than Marasmius oreades rings (the family's type species at 23 um/h); a ring radius growing about 0.7 m a year is 80 um/h

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

t_opt.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): subtropical and tropical lawns; fruits in hot wet weather

t_min.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): subtropical and tropical lawns; fruits in hot wet weather

t_max.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): subtropical and tropical lawns; fruits in hot wet weather

cold_drop.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): fruits in warm wet weather without a cold spell
